_: The evidence this page is willing to publish. A sibling checkout is byte transport; THIS is the pin. Every panel names the artifact, the immutable issuer commit its bytes came from, the sha256 those bytes must have, and a commit-pinned public URL a reader can fetch and hash themselves. A source whose bytes stop matching its pin renders STALE and loses its number: it never keeps yesterday's value. Bumping a pin is a deliberate edit here, never a side effect of someone else's push.
